```yaml
name: Agentics Maintenance

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  check-duplicate-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Detect duplicate latestVersions logic
        run: |
          set -e
          file1="build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts"
          file2="build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts"

          # Compare the two files ignoring the lines that differ only by variable names
          diff -I 'const stableVersions' -I 'let shouldDeploy' "$file1" "$file2" > /dev/null
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ Duplicate code detected in latestVersions logic."
            echo "Please refactor the logic to avoid duplication."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ No duplicate code detected."
          fi
```
